children: announced on Monday that it will redeem all outstanding 5.00% Series A Term Preferred Shares
The redemption price is $25 per share, in line with the terms of the preferred shares.
The redemption will be processed through the DTC and the company’s paying agent, Equiniti Trust.
After the redemption date, the shares will no longer be outstanding, and dividends will stop accruing.
The previously declared October 30 dividend will be paid separately in cash to shareholders of record as of October 13.
